 With Medicare open enrollment underway, understanding your healthcare coverage can be confusing, especially with so many phone calls, advertisements and plan options.
 Adult Protective Services is giving Beaumont residents an opportunity to get answers directly from Medicare professionals before making decisions about their coverage. 
 From reviewing your current Medicare plans to comparing plan options, the event offers on-on-one guidance to endure you understand the coverage, costs and benefits. 
 The event is set for Nov. 20 from 1 to 3 p.m. at the New Day Deliverance Holiness Church of Beaumont (1310 Van Buren St. in Beaumont).
